positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Women in Computing promotes, celebrates, and empowers women in Luddy to pursue a career in technology. As a web developer, I maintain our website with the latest events and opportunities to share with the WIC community. The website is developed in HTML, CSS, and Javascript with the Bootstrap framework and updates are pushed through Github and to the enterprise web server after internal code review.

positions.title: External Relations
positions.description: Skills: Email Management · Networking · Writing · Organization Skills

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: This project is a collaboration between the IU Computer Vision Lab, R-House Robotics Lab, and the Toyota Research Institute developing a social robot that interacts with older adults with cognitive impairments. I facilitated sessions with older adults where we go through activities to gather ideas on aspects of the robot like verbal cues, gestures, and facial expressions then implement them into QT robot. I also developed a Python program on ROS that parses audio from a push-to-talk mic, enabling the natural language processing pipeline.
positions.insights: Skills: Human-robot Interaction · Python (Programming Language) · Design · Robot Operating System (ROS) · Facilitation

company.name: Indiana University Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering

positions.title: Full Stack Developer Intern
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Enterprise Performance Management serves to unify data across all the different business units inside IBM. As a Full Stack Developer Intern, I created a tool that could tie out and validate financial data across different data stores. The front-end consisted of designing mockups in Figma then implementing them using resuable design components within the Vue.js framework. Data was fetched from Cloudant, a NoSQL database via private API endpoints developed in Node.js. The back-end work consisted of creating API endpoints that queried data from different data stores in Python, Apache Spark, and Flask.
positions.insights: Skills: NoSQL · Agile Methodologies · JavaScript · Jira · Vue.js

positions.title: Cloud Engineer Intern
positions.description:
The Client Engineering team within IBM co-creates with clients to showcase and deliver IBM products catered to the client's specific needs and use cases utilizing the Garage methodology. As a Cloud Engineer Intern serving signature accounts on the Financial Markets, I worked on an MVP build where I ingested and built Java objects off a client business process showcasing Red Hat Process Automation Manager's capabilities. I also synthesized and presented reports comparing classic versus cloud versions of different software resulting in the better usage of a $36 million enterprise license agreement. Additionally, I traveled to client headquarters in San Antonio to administer Design Thinking workshops, document questions, and manage the virtual component of a hybrid event resulting in over 13 ideas for further opportunity.

Outside my work for the team, I led an intern volunteer day where I coordinated weed and invasive species picking with the Lincoln Park Conservancy at North Pond. I also served as part of the Social Media Intern Advisory Council where I worked with another intern and created the recap video of all 100 2022 Sales Interns.

positions.title: Peer Advisor
positions.description: As a Peer Advisor at Luddy Career Services, I helped fellow students with their career-related questions at weekly drop-in hours. Additionally, I managed @luddycareers social media, creating content and posting on a regular schedule, increasing engagement within the community.
positions.insights: Skills: Social Media Marketing · Career Development · Peer Mentoring · Canva

company.name: Indiana University Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description: Trane Technologies is a HVAC and transport refrigeration company committed to challenging possible for a sustainable world. As a part of the Information Technology function, I streamlined an Alteryx workflow fetching project updates from JIRA from 600 connectors to a single iterative macro leading to a more dependable data process.  I also built Alteryx workflows and Tableau dashboards analyzing Alteryx and Tableau licenses across the business to identify key metrics leading to reallocation of resources based on these new insights.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Asian American Association at Indiana University-Bloomington
volunteerExperiences.description: As a AAA board member, I help organize events that connect members of the AAPI community at Indiana University. In addition to maintaining and updating the website with the latest events and forms, I implemented a photo gallery and archive section and added a calendar of events, executive board member cards, and a music playlist leading to a 70% increase in site views.

company.name: Asian American Association at Indiana University-Bloomington

projects.title: NillFill
projects.description: I participated in the Be(e) Innovative Challenge where I worked with five other interns to create a solution that combatted the issue of Waste Footprint. We narrowed our focus to food waste and designed NillFill, an application that informs users of when food actually goes bad versus the expiration or "best by" date utilizing IBM technologies like Watson Studio on Cloud Pak for Data, IBM Food Trust, and Cloudant storage. I created the architecture map and contributed to the presentation and UI mock-ups.

projects.title: Spotify Top 200 Song Classifier
projects.description: Classify whether a song will chart or not on Spotify's Top 200 Weekly Global Charts based off of the song's attributes. Programmed five different classification models in Python: Bayes Classifier, K-Nearest Neighbors, Random Forest, Decision Tree, and Neural Network.
